payment_orphan.subject: Alert: orphan payment recorded — transaction :id
payment_orphan.intro: An **orphan payment** has been recorded on the platform. The payment was charged in Stripe but the linked resource was not found in the database when processing the webhook (it may have been deleted between the checkout start and payment confirmation).
payment_orphan.instruction: Action required: review the payment in the admin panel and determine whether a manual refund should be issued or the payment should be linked to another resource.
